                      id  The meter id number.
                    name  Your name for the meter.
                   media  What does the meter measure?
                   meter  Meter driver.
               timestamp  Timestamp when wmbusmeters received the telegram. Local time for hr/fields UTC for json.
            timestamp_ut  Unix timestamp when wmbusmeters received the telegram.
            timestamp_lt  Local time when wmbusmeters received the telegram.
           timestamp_utc  UTC time when wmbusmeters received the telegram.
                  device  The wmbus device that received the telegram.
                rssi_dbm  The rssi for the received telegram as reported by the device.
                  prefix  The alphanumeric prefix printed before serial number on device.
           serial_number  The meter serial number.
                total_m3  The total water consumption recorded by this meter.
     last_month_total_m3  The total water consumption recorded by this meter around end of last month.
 last_month_measure_date  The date when the meter recorded the most recent billing value.
remaining_battery_life_y  How many more years the battery is expected to last
          current_alarms  Alarms currently reported by the meter.
         previous_alarms  Alarms previously reported by the meter.
       transmit_period_s  The period at which the meter transmits its data.
        manufacture_year  The year during which the meter was manufactured.
